Class AlgoTopCreateFromWatchlist

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.TenantBaseID
grafioschtrader.entities.AlgoTopAssetSecurity
grafioschtrader.entities.AlgoTop
grafioschtrader.algo.AlgoTopCreate
grafioschtrader.algo.AlgoTopCreateFromWatchlist
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AlgoTopCreateFromWatchlist extends AlgoTopCreate
DTO for auto-generating a complete AlgoTop hierarchy from the instruments of the linked watchlist. Extends AlgoTopCreate so the existing saveOnlyAttributes() dispatch can detect this subclass.

It carries no field of its own: the name and the watchlist are inherited from AlgoTop, and assetclassPercentageList stays unused because the buckets and their weights are derived from the watchlist rather than entered. A watchlist holds no amounts, so both levels are weighted equally - the asset classes among themselves and the instruments within their asset class.
